label: Necessary-being integration: contingent-existence dependence and productive-receipt warrant
summary:
Audited current main 7b7174f2c3090bbedb166d0e7b5bc8da0b939596 and owner issues #786/#750, preserving open PR #782/#785 ownership. Added an eight-family map covering all nine #786 candidate arguments to docs/notes/ultimate-adequacy-integration-735.md, with exact result/conclusion/premise/inference/argument/Lean/Comparator paths, one fixed actual contingent-concrete existence explanandum and explicit semantic interfaces. Rejected counting universal closure as an independent PSR defense, epistemic demands as ontic PSR, necessary facts as necessary concrete bearers, local coverage as global selection, mathematical uniqueness as productive explanation, rootness as absolute unexplainedness, and Supply as unity. The matched ground/law reduct leaves concrete support undecided; existing necessary-root trilemma leaves contingent-root and non-well-founded horns. Separated model comparisons rather than claiming separate reliability/root controls already form one certified rival. Priorities are P2 coverage/relevance, P3 actual concrete support, and well-foundedness of that same relation, not a proved globally minimal axiom set. Root map has 11 routes and 62 open premises (13 bare,49 sourced); necessary-concrete route and its dependence/WF premises remain off designated root paths. No root/configuration delta. No new source attribution or proof certificate; next task tests P3 against existing matched controls with independently defended source interpretation. Follow-up materialized/read full q3a4/q44a1 and Oppy sections I-II/VI-VII; P3 source audit in the same note identifies contingency-to-distinct/participated-esse, InAct-to-selected-world presence, cause concreteness and efficient-esse-cause-to-selected-support as separate application obligations. Existing existence-to-InAct is one-way; q44 corpus invokes earlier subsistent-esse/uniqueness, and q44 ad2 contests necessity-to-independence. Reused recorded existential-inertia replacement rather than treating it as brute denial of PSR; modern inertia articles were not freshly read. No new historical claims or statement identities.

2026-11-11 dependence follow-up, evidence revision 6d9b380099158c877373eaf34e2c6a9e4e6d01e4: complete proposed outcome for independent semantic challenge is in docs/notes/underived-essence-identity.md, Contingency-to-reception warrant assessment. Walked the strongest positive inference from modal contingency through intrinsic sufficiency, real distinction, explanatory coverage, productive receipt, self-cause exclusion and concurrent support; separated the warrant at each stage. Reused prior q3/q44/DeEnte/Pearce/Dasgupta/inertia readings, exact participation-route types, necessary-reason/necessitation theorem, existential-self-actualization certificate and participation omission/contingent-root controls. No new source reading or historical attribution. Necessary necessitating intrinsic reasons are excluded for a contingent target; this does not exclude contingent intrinsic conditions, nonnecessitating reasons or noncausal persistence laws. The intrinsic reply owes a noncircular full explanation or accepts primitive actuality; the law/earlier-state inertia reply owes existential no-loss scope but is not automatically an efficient self-cause; beginninglessness does not settle whole-history coverage. Empty-predicate omission models and the one-candidate root model are structural surrogates, not checked complete rival worldviews. Proposed judgment: the inspected argument does not independently warrant universal contingency-to-reception; it supplies explanatory motivation and a genuine restricted exclusion, while coverage and productive realization remain shared open bridges. No new theorem/result/claim, root premise or closure change. Proposed bearer-level no-input test and reopening conditions persist in the note; publication awaits fresh challenge review.
blocker: Independent warrant for contingency-to-productive receipt remains absent from the inspected argument. Need an independently justified productive-existential-input argument for the same actual bearer, or an independently defended existential no-loss law/adequacy criterion discriminating the strongest inertial and contingent-primitive replies. Neither persisted-state observation, powered-process analogy, necessary-reason exclusion nor efficient self-cause exclusion alone supplies universal reception. Same-world cause presence, concreteness, selected-ground correspondence, foundation and modal underivedness remain separate downstream obligations. Complete draft awaits coordinator-owned fresh semantic challenge; unchanged proof evidence is reused and final delivered-head CI retained.
